meta.description: How Go Cosmic processes personal data, audience measurement, email contacts, retention periods, rights, and CNIL complaints.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains how Go Cosmic handles personal data on this website and when you contact the studio by email.
privacy.legalNoticePrefix: For publisher and hosting details, see the

sections.title: Data controller
body: The data controller is Go Cosmic, represented by Matthieu Compérat. The studio can be contacted at support@gocosmic.dev for privacy requests.

sections.title: Data collected
body: The website has no account area, checkout, CAPTCHA, or advertising pixel. Two forms are handled server-side. The free mockup page collects your email address, the colour direction you pick, the address of your current website if you provide one, your message, and the language of the page. If you arrive from the pricing simulator, the request also includes the choices you made there — project type, site type, number of pages, selected options, update frequency and the resulting estimated monthly price — so the studio can answer with the full context. The contact form collects the name, email address and message you enter, plus your phone number, your business and the kind of need you picked, if you fill them in. In both cases the fields are forwarded to the studio mailbox by email and nothing is stored in a database. Messages sent through the mailto links are handled by your email client and the recipient mailbox instead.

Your IP address is processed transiently by the hosting provider's firewall, which limits both forms — the contact form and the free mockup form — to three submissions every ten minutes, alongside a hidden anti-spam field in each. Technical data may be processed by the hosting provider for security and delivery logs. Vercel Analytics is loaded only after consent to measure page views.

Two items are stored in your browser. The pricing simulation is kept only so it can follow you from the simulator to the free mockup form: it is sent to us only if you submit that form, is erased once the request is sent, and disappears when you close the tab. The dates of your recent contact form submissions are used to limit how often the form can be sent from the same browser and stay there until you clear your browser data; they are never sent to us.

sections.title: Purposes and legal bases
body: Email messages are processed to answer requests, prepare quotes, provide support, and keep evidence of exchanges. This processing is based on legitimate interest and, where applicable, pre-contractual steps requested by you. Free mockup requests are processed to prepare and send you the mockup you asked for, and to reply to you.

Messages sent through the contact form are processed for the same purposes. Limiting submissions per IP address and filtering automated submissions rely on the legitimate interest in protecting the service from abuse.

Audience measurement is used to understand aggregate traffic and improve the website. Go Cosmic loads Vercel Analytics only after your consent. Security logs are processed for legitimate interest in protecting the service.

sections.title: Recipients and processors
body: Data may be accessed by Go Cosmic, the email service provider, Resend (which delivers the free mockup and contact form emails), the hosting provider, and Vercel for hosting and analytics. LinkedIn is an external website and may process data under its own policy after you click an outbound link.

If you choose to book a call from the contact page, the booking calendar is provided by Google (Google Calendar), which processes the information you enter under its own privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy.

sections.title: Retention periods
body: Email exchanges are kept only for the time needed to handle the request and follow-up, then archived or deleted according to legal, accounting, or dispute limitation needs. Audience consent is stored in your browser until you clear local storage or change browsers. Hosting logs are retained according to the provider configuration.
Contact form submissions are not kept in a database: they are delivered as an email, and the resulting exchange follows the retention described above.

sections.title: International transfers
body: Some processors, including Vercel and email providers, may involve processing outside the European Economic Area.
Vercel frames these transfers using Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission. For questions about the applicable safeguards, contact support@gocosmic.dev.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection, and portability when applicable by writing to support@gocosmic.dev. You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL: https://www.cnil.fr/.

sections.title: Cookies and audience measurement
body: No advertising cookies are intentionally loaded by Go Cosmic. Vercel Analytics is treated as a non-essential audience measurement tool on this site and is loaded only after your consent.
You can modify or withdraw your consent at any time using the preference management button displayed at the bottom of every page.

The Google Calendar booking calendar on the contact page only loads if you click “Show the calendar”; Google may then set its own cookies. Without that click, nothing is loaded from Google and you can open the booking page in a new tab.

sections.title: Responsibility
body: Go Cosmic aims to keep information accurate and available but cannot guarantee that the website is free from interruptions, errors, or outdated content. External links lead to third-party services governed by their own terms and policies.

body: Cosmic Studio may integrate AI-assisted features into client projects, and uses these tools to write, translate and develop faster. Every piece of content and every delivery is reviewed by a person.
Recommendations produced by AI are informative and do not replace human judgement. Applications are tested according to industry best practices.
Sensitive data is not shared with third parties without a documented legal basis or explicit consent where required. Personal data practices are detailed in the privacy policy.

meta.title: Terms of Sale - Cosmic Studio

terms.title: Terms of sale
terms.intro: These terms of sale apply to the subscription and services offered by Cosmic Studio on www.gocosmic.dev.

sections.title: Provider
body: The provider is Cosmic Studio, represented by Matthieu Compérat, sole trader (Entreprise individuelle) registered since 17 October 2016 (SIRET 823 200 365 00026), 485 route de la champanaise, 74410 Duingt, France. Contact: support@gocosmic.dev.

sections.title: Free mockup
body: The mockup and the review of your current website are free and commit you to nothing. They are prepared from the information you send us.

sections.title: Subscribing
body: The subscription is confirmed in writing after a first conversation, once your needs (pages, options, changes) have been scoped together. It takes effect when the site goes online.

sections.title: Price and billing
body: Subscription prices are those shown on the Services & pricing page at the time of subscription, based on the options chosen. Billing is monthly, quarterly or annual, whichever you prefer.
Guidance, reinforcement and custom projects are billed at the day rate or on a quote, communicated before any work starts.

sections.title: Duration and commitment
body: The subscription has no minimum term and can be cancelled every month, as long as it does not include domain name or email management.
As soon as either of those two options is active, the subscription runs in 12-month periods, tacitly renewed, to cover the reservation of the domain name and the email address over that period.

sections.title: Options
body: You can add an option at any time; it takes effect from the next billing period.

The number of pages, the domain name, Swiss hosting and the email address cannot be removed once active, since each represents a commitment made on your behalf (pages built, domain reserved, mailbox opened). Only the content-updates frequency can be revised up or down.

sections.title: Cancellation
body: You can cancel at any time in writing. The site stays online until the end of the current paid period (end of the month for a subscription with no minimum term, end of the current 12-month period if it includes a domain name or an email address).
You leave with your content and your domain name.

sections.title: Ownership
body: Your text, images and domain name belong to you from day one. The site's code is handed over to you at no cost after 36 months of subscription. Before that, it can be handed over against a buyout fee that depends on the time remaining.
For a one-off project, the code is yours from delivery.

sections.title: Your commitments
body: You provide the text, images and information needed to build or update the site. Stated timelines start once we receive these.

sections.title: Liability and availability
body: Cosmic Studio takes reasonable steps to keep the site available, without guaranteeing it will never be interrupted. In case of a prolonged outage caused by Cosmic Studio, the affected period may be extended accordingly.

sections.title: Personal data
body: The processing of personal data is described in the privacy policy.

sections.title: Governing law and disputes
body: These terms are governed by French law. In the event of a dispute, an amicable solution is sought before any legal action; failing that, the competent courts are those of Cosmic Studio's registered address.
